scope.summary: Implement grow-into-garment fitting per Section 13.24 (REQ-024): the community dForce-timeline trick made native — a RefitMode extension that runs the cloth sim while ramping body channels from neutral to target, so extreme bodies (huge tits, obese builds) can be dressed in garments authored on the neutral shape without tunneling or explosion.
acceptance_criteria: RefitMode::GrowIntoGarment ramps the body's channel state neutral->target over a typed schedule (duration, substeps, easing) while the cloth sim steps continuously; collision proxies re-derive at each ramp step (MT-585 lane).
The refit runs as a cancellable Handshake job honoring scheduler leases; cancellation mid-ramp leaves no partial authority writes.

On archetype-(a)-class targets (petite frame + extreme-large perky natural tits) a starter bra/dress fitted from neutral reaches the target with zero final interpenetration and no solver explosion (degenerate-edge guard active).
The run is deterministic under the settlement policy: same garment + same target channels + same seed produces an identical settled drape (MeshComparator equality).
scope.risk_if_missed: Extreme bodies cannot be dressed at all — direct drape onto an already-extreme shape starts intersected and explodes, so the operator's primary body targets are locked out of every garment.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
